name: hki
description: HKI — Hermetic Knowledge Isolation runtime, conformance, and framework adapters.

scripts.test:hki-runtime-py: cd packages/hki-runtime-py && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-litellm: cd packages/hki-litellm && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-langchain: cd packages/hki-langchain && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-llamaindex: cd packages/hki-llamaindex && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-adk: cd packages/hki-adk && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-autogen: cd packages/hki-autogen && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-crewai: cd packages/hki-crewai && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-adapters: pnpm test:hki-litellm && pnpm test:hki-langchain && pnpm test:hki-llamaindex && pnpm test:hki-adk && pnpm test:hki-autogen && pnpm test:hki-crewai
scripts.test:hki-integration: cd packages/hki-integration-tests && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.test:hki-threats: cd packages/hki-runtime-py && uv run --extra dev pytest -q ../../examples/threats
scripts.verify:hki-conformance: pnpm build:hki-runtime && pnpm build:hki-conformance && pnpm --dir packages/hki-conformance conformance
